# ZIMR POLYMARKET BRIEFING | SAT JUNE 13, 2026

## "Gen.G Hype Machine Peaks While Peace Deal Markets Crater"

The market is pricing Gen.G as near-certain MSI favorites after yesterday's dominant performance, with both Game 3 and series winner contracts hitting 99%. This represents pure momentum trading—the +23% surge in Game 3 winner pricing in 24 hours tells you retail has piled in hard. Smart money should be watching whether this holds or if value emerges on KT Rolster at the series level once euphoria settles. The esports arbitrage window is closing fast.

Meanwhile, Iran ceasefire/peace deal markets are imploding. The June 12 extension contract collapsed from 14% to 1%—a -13% bleed in hours—suggesting either geopolitical pessimism shifted overnight or early-week optimism was pure speculation. The June 15 deal (16%, $4.2M) and June 30 permanent deal (42%, $1.6M) are now the real price discovery zones. The spread between these two suggests the market sees a *possible* framework emerging by month-end but near-zero confidence on imminent resolution. This is capitulation pricing.

World Cup long-shot markets are pulling minor volume from majors but showing zero conviction. USA at 2% and Paraguay at 1% are lottery ticket positions, not theses. Brazil's -2% pullback despite being heavy favorites for today's match is the real tell—bettors are hedging or taking profits ahead of the game.

---

## WATCH LIST

**1. US x Iran June 15 Deal (16%, $4.2M vol)**  
The most-watched near-term catalyst. Any credible news cycle shift sends this exploding or imploding. This is your volatility play.

**2. LoL Gen.G Series Winner (99%)**  
Approaching maximum saturation. If KT wins even one map, the repricing will be swift and brutal. Contrarian value setup if odds stay this high.

**3. Brazil vs Match Today (57%, $1.5M vol)**  
World Cup liquidity concentrating here. Watch if this breaks 60%+ (smart money piling in) or collapses below 50% (sharp reversals).
